This appears to be the case. Bateman will go to Owner 0004.
Since Owner 0002 had Bateman in the starting lineup I replaced him with the player with the highest projected points he had in reserve.
Doesn’t the fact that Owner 0002 went over the salary cap with the Bateman waiver transaction mean he didn’t really win Bateman?
We don't have first come first serve waivers until after the blind bidding so this wasn't a legal picked. I will be reversing it.
So the FA waivers gate was inadvertently left open?
Correct. The calendar is the authority (and we talked about it during the draft). A commish oversight doesn’t override that.
I'm not gonna be a jerk about it.  I understand the oversight and thought maybe I missed something when I saw the opportunity.  Thank you!
